notes: CardiacLens user-facing Location Status / Check My Location proof test.
summary: Adds a clear Location Status section in Log Activity so users can confirm CardiacLens can receive live latitude/longitude before starting GPS activity tracking.
label: LocationStatusProofTest
whatsNew: Renames the GPS proof workflow to user-facing Location Status / Check My Location.
Check My Location displays CardiacLens latitude, longitude, accuracy, and timestamp when a live coordinate is received.
The map marker is shown only from live CardiacLens latitude/longitude, not the fallback map preview.
Adds clear privacy wording that location is used only when the user checks location or enables GPS for supported outdoor/mixed activity tracking.
fixes: Check My Location no longer turns on the activity GPS tracking checkbox by itself.
Improves user-facing wording so the feature is useful for real users, not just engineering testing.
Keeps GPS route tracking separate from the manual location check.
